    All Packages

    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    chess.app
    Provides the application entry point and console-based interaction for the chess movement validation program.
    chess.board
    Defines chessboard coordinate validation, including the permitted rows and columns for positions on a standard eight-by-eight board.
    chess.enums
    Defines enumerated values used throughout the chess program, including chess piece types, piece colors, and chessboard columns.
    chess.exceptions
    Defines custom exceptions that describe invalid chess pieces, invalid board coordinates, and illegal movement requests.
    chess.figures
    Contains the chess piece implementations and their shared Figure base class.
    chess.interfaces
    Declares the interfaces that specify shared contracts for chess pieces, bishop movement, and chessboard validation.
